before_metrics.comment: Mechanism switch after cross-sectional OHLCV probes all reduced to momentum (003/006/007/008). Tests time-of-day return structure (overnight anomaly), orthogonal to cross-sectional selection.

change_summary: Decomposes each (ticker,day) close-to-close return on the broad 1446-ticker all-windows-full-liquid universe into overnight (prev_close->open) and intraday (open->close) components, equal-weight daily cross-sectional means, aggregated across the canonical 3 windows, with a 50pct per-component clip (split/bad-print guard) and a 50-name/day floor. Result: the textbook overnight-return anomaly does NOT robustly appear. Overnight daily mean +0.044pct (t=1.15, insignificant), intraday +0.036pct (t=0.67), overnight-minus-intraday t=0.11 (statistically indistinguishable). Overnight share of close-to-close is only 55.7pct (vs ~100pct+ in the literature). 2/3 windows positive (old_thin overnight negative). Returns split roughly evenly between sessions; no robust overnight-timing structure on this liquid large/mid-cap survivorship universe over this 18-month sample.
decision_rule: Accept the overnight-premium structure if mean overnight daily return has t>=2, majority-positive windows, AND overnight-minus-intraday has t>=2. Tradeable-edge claims would require an open/close execution and cost study not performed here. None of the significance conditions held.

gate_questions.what_hypothesis: Does the close-to-close premium accrue mostly overnight (overnight anomaly) on the broad universe?
gate_questions.prior_similar_experiments: None in repo on overnight/intraday structure. Prior session probes (003/006/007/008) were all cross-sectional momentum.
gate_questions.single_independent_variable: Overnight vs intraday return component means (time-of-day decomposition).
gate_questions.success_failure_criteria: Overnight mean t>=2, majority windows, AND overnight-minus-intraday t>=2.
gate_questions.reproducibility: Deterministic: warehouse all_windows_full_liquid, prev_close/open/close decomposition, daily cross-sectional means, t-stats. 5 unit tests.

hypothesis: Overnight vs intraday return decomposition on the broad 1446-ticker universe: the equity premium accrues mostly OVERNIGHT (prev_close->open) while the intraday session (open->close) is flat or negative. Mean overnight return should be significantly positive (t>=2, majority windows) and materially larger than mean intraday. Orthogonal to cross-sectional momentum; relevant to core next-day-open entry timing.
next_evidence_needed: No overnight-timing edge on this universe: the core's next-day-open entry is not leaving an obvious overnight premium on the table. Revisiting would need a small/micro-cap universe (where the anomaly concentrates) or a longer multi-regime sample, AND a daily open/close turnover cost study, since capturing the premium requires heavy turnover the literature debates as hard to monetize. Closes time-of-day structure as a near-term lever on this universe.

prediction.outcome_vs_prediction: matched: intraday_not_negative_just_smaller + effect_not_robust_across_windows. Overnight and intraday statistically indistinguishable (diff t=0.11); overnight share only 55.7pct.
